title: Chinni Tammudu Chitti Chellelu – Blessy Kingsley Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: చిన్ని చిన్ని తమ్ముడు – చిట్టి చిట్టి చెల్లెలు
యేసయ్య మాటను వింటున్నావా… ఓ ఓ ఓ ఓ
యేసయ్య మాటను వింటున్నావా… ఓ ఓ ఓ ఓ
యేసయ్య మాటను వింటున్నావా… ఓ ఓ ఓ ఓ
english: Chinni chinni thammudu chitti chitti chellelu
translation: Little, little brother and tiny, tiny sister,
Are you listening to the word of Jesus?
Are you listening to the word of Jesus?
1. Jonah did not listen to the word of God,
But the fish followed God’s command.
Are you listening to God’s word or not?
For true worship is found in obeying His word!
2. Balaam rejected the word of God,
But the donkey spoke on behalf of God.
Are you listening to God’s word or not?
For true worship is found in obeying His word!
intro: Chinni Tammudu Chitti Chellelu is the latest Telugu Christian Children song written & tuned by Blessy Kingsley, sung by Shilohi Kingsley and music composed by Sudhakar Rella. This song was released on January 1, 1970, through Shilohi Kingsley YouTube Channel.
